name: week
title: Coordination week
subtitle: Recorded requests, resources and follow-up. Confirm real conditions with the responsible people.

sections.title: Request queue
sections.sql: select code,name,program,quantity,unit,status,reserved,received,unallocated,due from request_queue order by due,code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from attention order by due nulls first,code

sections.title: Stock and commitments
sections.note: Received stock remains consumed. These records do not dispatch supplies.
sections.sql: select code,item,unit,quantity,reserved,received,available,inspection_due,state from resource_balance order by code

sections.title: Evidence and dates
sections.note: Record checks are not legal certification. Testing intervals are chosen in the plan.
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,jurisdiction,review_due,next_test,gaps from readiness order by code
